reasoning_content:
Docker and Docker Compose are available. I need to install the following:
- uv
- process-compose
- Node.js 24
- pnpm 10.30.2

Let me check the system environment (OS, architecture, package manager) and network access.

action.command: cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "---arch---"; uname -m; echo "---cpu/mem---"; nproc; free -h 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo "---disk---"; df -h / /workspace 2>/dev/null; echo "---docker ps---"; docker ps 2>&1 | head -5; echo "---docker info---"; docker info 2>&1 | grep -E "Server Version|Storage|Cgroup|Kernel|OSType" | head -10
